slice.title: Add product stock tracking
slice.goal: Extend the existing products-app prototype with stock quantity on product records and an availability filter based on stock quantity.
acceptance_criteria: Existing product catalog create, edit, list, name/SKU search, and category filter behavior remains working.
User can enter stock quantity when creating a product.
User can edit stock quantity for an existing product.
Product list displays stock quantity or a clear stock/availability indication for each product.
User can filter products by availability: in stock and out of stock.
The incremental run modifies the existing product catalog implementation instead of recreating a separate product app.
constraints: Use --from-run with a successful products-app run as baseline.
Preserve existing /api/products route and root product catalog screen.
Preserve existing name/SKU search and category filter behavior.
Prefer modify operations for existing product files over duplicate create operations.
No inventory reservation, supplier integration, order management, or warehouse workflow.
Continue using local JSON mock storage.
non_goals: Separate warehouse or stock management screen.
notes: This scenario is intended to validate incremental modification through prepare_run_from_scenario.py --from-run.
The baseline should be a successful run of samples/products-app, for example runs/run-004-products-app-browser.
This is an incremental scenario, not a greenfield product catalog.
Use it after a successful products-app run to verify that the pipeline can preserve and extend existing generated code.
